model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effects of various genetic elements across different language families and isolated groups, with the vertical axis representing the "effect" on a scale from 0 to 30 and the horizontal axis categorizing data by language family (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) and a "family" label for the IE-Slavic group. Each category on the x-axis displays a group of five bars, each corresponding to a different genetic element: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), as indicated by the legend in the top right corner. Error bars are present on each bar, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements. The effects vary significantly across categories; for instance, the IE-Indic group shows the highest effects for all elements, particularly mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂, with values exceeding 20. In contrast, the Isolate and Uralic groups show very low effects for most elements, generally below 5. The chart reveals that the XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ elements consistently show higher effects than their L₂ counterparts in most language families, with notable exceptions in the IE-Indic and Semitic groups where mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ also exhibit high effects.
